crm.get_notes.description: Get notes for a deal. Notes are free text written by sales reps.

crm.list_deals.description: List deals. Paginated: pass the returned next_cursor to get the next page. Optional stage filter.
conventions: The tool paginates results using 'next_cursor'. To get all items, calls must be made repeatedly, passing the 'next_cursor' value as the 'cursor' argument until 'next_cursor' is null.
The `list_deals` tool requires pagination by passing the `next_cursor` value from the previous response as the `cursor` argument until `next_cursor` is null.
